data.name: Aminat
data.gender_notes: Aminat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aminat is a beautiful Arabic name for girls which means 'faithful' and 'trustworthy'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'amin' meaning 'reliable'. The name is mentioned in the Quran and is attributed to the wife of Prophet Moses (peace be upon him). The name Aminat carries the meaning “Faithful, Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aminat usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with faith and trust.
data.etymology: Aminat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Trustworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aminat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
